headline: US strikes Qeshm missile site as Iran attacks Gulf states, escalating regional conflict
subheadline: US jets hit an IRGC missile launch on Qeshm Island; Iran’s drones ignited two fires in northern Kuwait and struck Bahrain twice and Kuwait once.
lede: US fighter jets struck an IRGC missile launch on Qeshm Island in a self‑defense operation, while Iran launched drone attacks that ignited two fires in northern Kuwait and hit Bahrain twice and Kuwait once. Iraqi Prime Minister Al‑Zaidi ordered armed forces into Jurf al‑Sakhar, demanding withdrawal of the IRGC‑backed Kataib Hezbollah. Israeli airstrikes hit Wadi al‑Saluqi, Al‑Mansouri, and Hula, with artillery shelling nine locations across southern Lebanon, recording 99 alerts. In Ukraine, a FP‑5 “Flamingo” missile collapsed the Crimean Bridge’s car span for the second time in two days, halting traffic, while German and Norwegian aid packages of $300 million each were pledged for Patriot and NASAMS systems.

sections.title: US‑Iran Front Escalates Across Gulf Region
sections.body: US fighter jets hit an IRGC missile launch on Qeshm Island, a self‑defense strike confirmed by CENTCOM. Iran responded with drone attacks, igniting two fires in northern Kuwait and striking Bahrain twice and Kuwait once, prompting Kuwaiti air‑defence engagement. Iraqi PM Al‑Zaidi ordered forces into Jurf al‑Sakhar, giving Kataib Hezbollah a deadline to withdraw. Israeli airstrikes targeted Wadi al‑Saluqi, Al‑Mansouri, and Hula, while artillery shelled nine southern Lebanese locations, generating 99 alerts.

sections.title: Crimean Bridge Hit Again, Drone Waves Continue
sections.body: A FP‑5 “Flamingo” missile collapsed the Crimean Bridge’s car span for the second time in two days, halting traffic and navigation on the Kerch Strait. The SBU detailed a month‑long seven‑stage operation in which “Alpha” used “Palianytsia” drone missiles to destroy the bridge’s vehicle section. A military transport An‑12 crashed near Kemerovo, killing all 17 servicemen, while Germany and Norway pledged $300 million each for a new PURL package focused on Patriot missiles and NASAMS systems. Additional Shahed waves moved from Zhytomyr to Rivne and from Kyiv into Zhytomyr districts, and a “Banderol” cruise missile circled over Poltava.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous US strike on Qeshm Island and Iranian drone attacks on Bahrain and Kuwait mark the first direct kinetic exchanges between the two adversaries, signaling a sharp escalation. Iraq’s push against Kataib Hezbollah under US pressure and Israel’s intensified southern Lebanon operations indicate a coordinated effort to constrain Iranian proxy activity across multiple fronts. In Ukraine, the repeated targeting of the Crimean Bridge, expanding drone campaigns, and new Western aid packages demonstrate Russia’s vulnerability of key infrastructure and the evolving battlefield dynamics.
